display_long_description:
The Most Relaxing Fishing Trip in VR — Real VR Fishing

Cast your line across meticulously recreated real-world landscapes. 40 maps and 150+ species in the base game expand to 100+ fishing spots and 300+ species with DLC. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned angler, enjoy  at your own pace in a calm, unhurried world.

[media]

**Cast, Wait, Feel the Bite**

From casting to reeling, every action delivers lifelike resistance. Keep it easy in Normal Mode, or test your skills  in Expert Mode.
[media]


**Solo, or Up to 4 Players Together**

Share the same fishing spot with friends, chat in real time, and enjoy the catch together. Real VR Fishing is more than a game,  it's a place to unwind together.

[media]


**Collect, Progress, Customize**

Level up, release rare fish, and build out your avatar and your own personal aquarium. 

Show your flair by changing up your avatar with our many costume packs. Proudly display your catches in your personal aquarium, and add a touch of beauty with rocks, greenery and trophies from events.

[media]


**A New Adventure: Picnic Festa DLC**

Explore 7 picnic-themed locations across the US, Spain, and Japan. Rescue Chubby Fish and Starving Sharks, and restore balance to a strangely evolving ecosystem.

[media]

**Always Growing**

Winner of Oculus Game of the Year 2019. Regular  updates and seasonal events keep adding new species and challenges.

For more contents and information, join our anglers' Discord!
https://discord.gg/sUwKtzFvnM
